title: BLOCK-001 Reassessment

q1_strengthens.question: Does AB-1 strengthen BLOCK-001 evidence?
q1_strengthens.answer: YES — AB-1 provides independently scored evidence from actual code artifacts (Vanilla 65, Factory 90, +25). Scores are NOT reused from AB-0 design. Harness directories contain real code.

q2_resolves_provenance.question: Does it resolve AB-0-R2 provenance concern?
q2_resolves_provenance.answer: YES — AB-1 scores (65/90) differ from AB-0 scores (50/87). Scoring is based on actual code artifact inspection with per-dimension evidence paths. No score reuse.

q3_status.question: Is BLOCK-001 still partial or resolved?
q3_status.answer: STRONG_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE — Two independent trials now exist (AB-0-R1 structured analysis + AB-1 code artifacts). Evidence is stronger but limited to one project type. Not fully resolved.

q4_more_needed.question: Is another trial needed?
q4_more_needed.answer: OPTIONAL — AB-2 on a different project type would further strengthen generalizability. But two trials with consistent Factory advantage is substantial evidence.

q5_rc.question: Is RC planning reasonable?
q5_rc.answer: YES — With STRONG_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE, 17/18 READY criteria, and Memory Quality P2+P3 integrated, RC planning is well-supported. RC is NOT release.

q6_v05.question: Is v0.5 still blocked?
q6_v05.answer: YES — v0.5 remains BLOCKED. BLOCK-002/003/004 still active.

block001_new_status: STRONG_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE — two independent trials show Factory advantage; code artifacts confirm independent scoring
